headline_marked: First batch of [[uranium arrives for Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant]]
headline: First batch of uranium arrives for Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant
summary: The nuclear fuel from Russia landed in Dhaka and is being transported to the project site under heavy security by the Bangladesh Army.
details: The first batch of uranium has arrived in Dhaka from Russia and is being transported to the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant project site.
A special chartered cargo flight landed at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport at 11:44 PM last night, delivering the nuclear fuel.
The Bangladesh Army is overseeing the transport of the fuel in three special lorries, starting the journey to the project site at 7:00 AM today.
To ensure safety, the 200-kilometre highway from the airport to Rooppur has been designated as a 'green passage,' with one lane stopped to keep the highway clear.
The convoy, under tight security, crossed the Jamuna Bridge at approximately 9:10 AM today.
The nuclear fuel will be stored at the project site upon arrival.
According to Md Golam Mahabub, chief of administration of the power plant, a total of nine flights will be required to transport nuclear fuel for Unit-1 and the commissioning of Unit-2.
caption:
Bangladesh's first nuclear fuel shipment has arrived. Under heavy army security, uranium from Russia is now on its way to Rooppur.

The first batch of uranium has arrived in Dhaka from Russia and is being transported to the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant project site.

A special chartered cargo flight landed at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport at 11:44 PM last night, delivering the nuclear fuel.

The Bangladesh Army is overseeing the transport of the fuel in three special lorries, starting the journey to the project site at 7:00 AM today.

To ensure safety, the 200-kilometre highway from the airport to Rooppur has been designated as a 'green passage,' with one lane stopped to keep the highway clear.

The convoy, under tight security, crossed the Jamuna Bridge at approximately 9:10 AM today.

The nuclear fuel will be stored at the project site upon arrival.

According to Md Golam Mahabub, chief of administration of the power plant, a total of nine flights will be required to transport nuclear fuel for Unit-1 and the commissioning of Unit-2.

Source: Jamuna TV, The Daily Star

headline_marked: Flydubai [[co-pilot attacked pilot with axe]] during flight
headline: Flydubai co-pilot attacked pilot with axe during flight
summary: The UAE prosecutor general reports that the co-pilot of flight FZ1073 attempted to take control of the aircraft in a 'terrorist' attack.
details: The co-pilot of flydubai flight FZ1073 attempted to carry out a "terrorist" attack while the plane was in the air, according to the UAE prosecutor general.
The attacker used an axe to attack the pilot in the cockpit, attempting to seize control of the aircraft.
UAE authorities are currently conducting investigations to determine the motives, circumstances, and any potential connections behind the attack.
Investigators are also examining physical and digital evidence to uncover the full details of the incident.
caption:
A flydubai co-pilot used an axe to attack his fellow pilot in the cockpit to seize control of the plane.

The co-pilot of flydubai flight FZ1073 attempted to carry out a "terrorist" attack while the plane was in the air, according to the UAE prosecutor general.

The attacker used an axe to attack the pilot in the cockpit, attempting to seize control of the aircraft.

UAE authorities are currently conducting investigations to determine the motives, circumstances, and any potential connections behind the attack.

Investigators are also examining physical and digital evidence to uncover the full details of the incident.
